biomarkers.biomarker_other: blood-brain barrier-associated protein expression and transcriptional signatures in resected tumour

source_quote.quote: Expression of blood-brain barrier-associated proteins within resected glioblastoma tissue assessed by immunohistochemical analysis.

coder_notes: Observational-style diagnostic assessment registered as interventional; no drug is administered. Gadolinium contrast is mentioned only in passing as part of the MRI, so no agent is listed. The serum markers (S100B, GFAP etc.) are blood injury markers, not tumour molecular biomarkers. cns5_terminology coded historical because the record uses 'glioblastoma multiforme'.
